intent: Cut the fixes/lib test suite's runtime from 110s to 37s so the commit/push cycle stops being dominated by it, without weakening a single assertion.
changes: thorium_repairs.sh's hardcoded `sleep 4` is now `sleep ${THORIUM_STARTUP_WAIT:-4}`; the harness sets 0.2s. Three cases paid four real seconds each.
_t_hide now builds ONE farm of every executable on PATH and hard-links it per tool set with `cp -al`, instead of walking PATH and creating ~13.5k symlinks for each distinct set
The farm cache moved out of $TEST_TMPDIR into a run-scoped dir exported by run_all.sh, because each test file gets a fresh tmpdir and the cache never survived between files
Split _t_hide and the farm into lib_test_path.sh; lib_test_core.sh had reached exactly 250 lines

verification.evidence: 110.0s at session start -> 98.5s after the sleep seam -> 84.6s after the run-scoped cache -> 36.7s after the hard-linked farm. Exit 0 throughout.

verification.command: Per-file timing of the slowest files
verification.evidence: test_thorium_repairs_deep.sh 17041ms -> 5563ms. A single _t_hide farm build measured 4645ms, with ~16 distinct tool sets per run.

verification.command: bash run_all.sh | grep -c '^  OK' and '^  FAIL'
verification.evidence: 645 OK, 0 FAIL. No assertion was deleted, skipped or weakened.

verification.command: Targeted re-check that the 'not installed' branches still hide
verification.evidence: install_pyroveil's missing-dependency cases and fix_aggressive's sqlite3-absent case all still pass; they assert on behaviour only reachable when the tool is genuinely unfindable, so a broken farm would fail them loudly.

verification.command: shellcheck + wc -l on both split files
verification.evidence: lib_test_core.sh 194 lines, lib_test_path.sh 67 lines, both clean with zero suppressions.

risks: `cp -al` hard-links symlinks; if a future _t_hide caller mutated the farm in place it would corrupt the shared copy. Callers only ever read it and the per-set copy is what gets the deletions.
The shared farm assumes PATH does not change mid-run. _t_full_path restores the same original PATH, so the assumption holds for this suite.
THORIUM_STARTUP_WAIT shortens a real timing check to 0.2s in tests; the stubbed browser sleeps 30s, so the process is still comfortably alive when kill -0 runs.
rollback: git revert the commit; the suite returns to ~110s with identical assertions
Re-run run_all.sh and confirm 645 OK / 0 FAIL is unchanged
